fato_historico: 1810: A large fire destroys a third of all the buildings in the town of Raahe in the Grand Duchy of Finland.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound realization about resilience. Just as a town once rose from the ashes of a great fire, you may feel an urge to rebuild or redefine your personal goals. It is a good time to clear away what no longer serves your spirit and focus on building a stronger, more vibrant foundation for your future.
frase_do_dia: Every ending is simply a beautiful chance to build something much stronger.
significado_numero: Represents the energy of building a legacy through wisdom and patience.
conselho: Consider letting go of old worries to make space for fresh, lucky beginnings.
